description: Insulation contractor in Albany, CA, 17 miles north of our San Leandro base. Attic, crawl space and wall insulation. Schedule an inspection.
intro: Albany sits about 17 miles north of our San Leandro base, well inside the service area we cover across the East Bay. Homeowners there call us for attic and crawl space work, and for air sealing. Each job starts with a free inspection at the house.

paragraphs: Albany is about 17 miles north of San Leandro, so a visit to your house is a routine drive for our crew.
The crew that inspects your home is the crew that does the install and the follow-up.

sections.h2: The services Albany homeowners call for
paragraphs: Most requests from Albany cover attic insulation, crawl space sealing and air sealing.
bullets: Crawl space encapsulation and vapor barriers
Blown-in insulation for walls and garage ceilings
Rodent proofing and exclusion before reinsulation

paragraphs: We inspect first and quote second. You get a written estimate before any work begins, and the price stays fixed once you approve it.
bullets: Free inspection with a written estimate
The same crew from inspection to install
We return after the install to confirm the work held

faqs.q: How far is Albany from your base?
faqs.a: Albany is about 17 miles north of our San Leandro base, inside the roughly 30 mile radius we cover.

faqs.q: Do you replace old attic insulation in Albany?
faqs.a: Yes. We remove old or damaged material and install new insulation to current standards. The inspection shows what is there before we quote.

faqs.q: Do you seal crawl spaces in Albany?
faqs.a: Yes. Crawl space encapsulation and vapor barriers are a regular part of our work there, and the inspection tells us what your crawl space needs.
